objective: refine Gate 00F requirements from official UniVTAC, TaCauchy, TacEx, and IsaacLabTactile source without running heavy work on the login node

univtac.official_role: visuo-tactile manipulation benchmark and schema reference
source_findings: README describes a tactile-aware manipulation benchmark built on NVIDIA Isaac Lab and TacEx/UIPC.
README lists Lift Bottle, Lift Can, Insert HDMI, Insert Hole, Insert Tube, Pull Out Key, Put Bottle in Shelf, and Grasp & Classify tasks.
README records ACT, ACT ablations, and ViTAL baselines and currently limits data collection/evaluation to GelSight Mini.
scripts/install.sh creates a UniVTAC conda env, installs Isaac Sim 4.5 / Isaac Lab v2.1.1 style dependencies, installs TacEx and cuRobo, and runs heavy examples.
encoder/dataloader.py exposes left/right tactile HDF5 fields for rgb_marker, marker, depth, rgb, and pose.
univtac.gate00f_implication: UniVTAC can validate left/right tactile RGB, marker, depth, and pose schemas, but only after an official dependency-complete environment and official sanity pass.

tacauchy.official_role: FEM tactile mechanics and force-field semantic reference
source_findings: README describes direct Cauchy stress extraction, contact traction recovery, adaptive mesh refinement, and multi-sensor support.
README describes physics-first force fields with normal pressure and tangential traction.
REPRODUCTION.md requires Ubuntu 22.04, GPU/CUDA, Python 3.11, Isaac Sim 5.0.0, Isaac Lab v2.2.1, GCC 11.4, CMake >= 3.26, and vcpkg.
REPRODUCTION.md demo entrypoints include simple_tactile_demo.py, contact_force_visualization_demo_modular.py, and benchmark_tactile_performance.py.
ASSETS.md records that large USD/calibration/texture assets are not fully included in source and must be installed separately.
GelSight Mini configs expose tactile_rgb, marker_motion, height_map, camera_depth, and camera_rgb style fields at 320x240 tactile image resolution.
tacauchy.gate00f_implication: TaCauchy is the right official reference for stress, pressure, and tangential traction semantics, but it needs dependency-complete Isaac/TacEx/UIPC readiness and official demo sanity before Newton candidate channels can be promoted.

tacex.official_role: shared TacEx tactile simulator source used by UniVTAC/TaCauchy reference paths
tacex.gate00f_implication: TacEx is reference source evidence, but it does not clear Gate 00F without a working official Isaac/TacEx/UIPC environment and sanity outputs.

source_findings: Local README is generic Isaac Lab documentation, with sensors described as RGB/depth/segmentation cameras, IMU, contact sensors, and ray casters.
Static search found generic contact-sensor force paths such as net force readout, but no obvious TacSL, GelSight, Taxim, FOTS, or TacEx tactile demo entrypoint in the local clone.
The clone was acquired with LFS smudge skipped; .gitattributes marks large USD/OBJ/MP4/PT/HDF5-style assets as LFS, so asset completeness is unverified while git-lfs is unavailable.
isaaclab_tactile.gate00f_implication: Current IsaacLabTactile source is not an adequate replacement for UniVTAC/TaCauchy official semantic validation. It can remain a source gap/reference candidate only until a concrete tactile entrypoint and asset-complete official sanity are identified.
